# `end_of_line`

Line ending to write. auto matches the platform's own (Environment.NewLine), the same default Roslyn uses.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `lf` |  |
| `crlf` |  |
| `auto` |  |

**Default:** `auto`

## Conformance

No known case where Curb's output is not a fixed point of `dotnet format` — see [conformance](../../design-principles/conformance.md).

### `end_of_line = lf`

```ini
end_of_line = lf
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; set; }

    public int Double()
    {
        return Value * 2;
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; set; }

    public int Double()
    {
        return Value * 2;
    }
}
```
:::

::::
